dish 106 printed as one dish with two protein prices. Correct price '£20.95 / £23.95' (Chicken / Prawn or Seafood), was recorded as £20.95 only.
unverified: Section boundaries for dishes 98-105 — dish names and prices are verified, but the printed heading they sit under is not. Listed under Chef's Specials as a best guess.
